synopsis: OpenDRIVE is part of the booklet’s proposed simulation integration stack, alongside OpenSCENARIO, OSI, FMI, OpenUSD and ROS 2; it also appears among the critical inputs for scene, dynamics and sensor simulation [f913, f8335, f15862]. OpenDRIVE version 1.9.0, dated May 2026, describes road networks, including lanes, lane geometry, road marks and junctions [f13201]. Its road assumptions suit structured haul roads but fit lane-free job sites poorly: dig faces, stockpiles and free terrain need additional representations, and the program needs its own job-site operating-domain taxonomy [f8337, f13202, f9361]. Accordingly, the booklet recommends OpenDRIVE only for structured haul roads, OpenUSD and OpenMATERIAL for scenes, and OpenSCENARIO exports where required; OpenUSD and general 3D asset pipelines are at least as strategically important as OpenDRIVE [f13216, f9363]. Listed implementations include MathWorks, Cadence VTD/VTDx and CARLA, but OpenDRIVE or OpenSCENARIO compatibility demonstrates data exchange rather than physical fidelity [f8383, f8986, f9011, f8921].
